event: Illegal contact / defensive holding points-of-emphasis crackdown
mechanism_touched: Strict enforcement of the 5-yard-downfield incidental-contact limit on defenders covering receivers
expected_signal_families: penalties; QB availability (pass efficiency, indirect); coach fade
notes: Points-of-emphasis, not a rule-text change. Reported (unverified by this agent): illegal-contact fouls rose from 79 to 191 league-wide that season, cited by a 2014 Washington Post retrospective, not a 2004 primary count.

event: Kickoff spot moved from the 30-yard line to the 35-yard line
mechanism_touched: Shortens the distance a returner has to build speed before contact; touchback spot stayed at the 20
expected_signal_families: kicking; home advantage (field position); coach fade
notes: Reported (unverified by this agent): touchback rate rose from 16.4% to 43.5% and return rate fell from 80.1% to 53.4% year over year, per ESPN Stats & Info figures surfaced in search.

event: 2011 CBA ends lockout: shorter offseason program, OTAs capped at 10, year-round full-contact practice limits, rookie wage scale
mechanism_touched: Less padded/contact practice time per team per year, especially for rookies; lockout also compressed the 2011 offseason calendar
notes: Lockout ran March 12, 2011 - July 25, 2011 (reported, unverified beyond this Wikipedia summary). Practice-limit numbers reported by search-engine synthesis, not read from the CBA text itself.

event: Regular-season overtime adopts modified sudden death (both teams get a possession unless the first team scores a TD)
mechanism_touched: Removes the pure first-score-wins dynamic for field goals in regular-season OT
notes: Extends a rule the league had already used in the playoffs since the 2010 season.

event: Second illegal-contact / defensive-holding crackdown (echo of 2004)
mechanism_touched: Same 5-yard contact rule, re-emphasized to officiating crews for the 2014 preseason/season
notes: Points-of-emphasis, not a rule-text change. Effective date is approximate (preseason-2014 press coverage); no single owners'-meeting vote found tied to this one.

event: Extra point moved to the 15-yard line (a 33-yard kick); 2-point tries stay at the 2; blocked/returned PATs and failed 2-point tries become returnable for 2 points
mechanism_touched: Lowers PAT success rate from near-automatic and adds a rare defensive-scoring path
notes: Approved 30-2 by owners at the 2015 spring meeting (reported).

event: Touchback spot on kickoffs moved from the 20-yard line to the 25-yard line
mechanism_touched: Makes touchbacks a better outcome for the receiving team than most returns, pushing kicking teams toward shorter/higher kicks
notes: Started as a one-year trial explicitly revocable if it didn't reduce injuries; stayed in force through the 2023 season (superseded by the 2024 dynamic-kickoff overhaul).

event: 10-second run-off rule expanded to apply after the two-minute warning (previously only the final minute of each half)
mechanism_touched: Widens the window in which a trailing offense can be charged a 10-second clock run-off for a penalty-caused stoppage
notes: The underlying run-off rule dates to 1955 and picked up a replay-reversal provision in 2010 and a play-clock-reset tweak in 2023; this row marks the 2017 scope expansion specifically.

event: Secular rise in 4th-down go-for-it aggressiveness, commonly dated to Doug Pederson's Philadelphia Eagles (hired 2016, Super Bowl LII win at the end of the 2017 season) building on earlier academic work (Romer 2006) and analytics-media advocacy
mechanism_touched: Coaches trade expected-points-optimal 4th-down decisions against the historical punt/kick-heavy norm
notes: Not a rule change; a meta-game shift with an admittedly fuzzy, multi-year boundary. Reported (unverified primary counts): 4th-and-2 go-for-it rate ~20% in the first 12 weeks of 2009 vs. ~42% in 2024; NFL Next Gen Stats' Decision Guide 'go' recommendation follow-rate rose from 31% in 2017 (its introduction) to 53% in 2020. season_effective=2017 is a placeholder midpoint (Eagles' Super Bowl season) for a trend Task B's go-rate series should locate empirically rather than assume.

event: Regular-season overtime period shortened from 15 minutes to 10 minutes
mechanism_touched: Raises tie probability and shortens the tail of very long games ahead of short-week schedule spots
notes: Framed by the league as a player-safety measure (short-week/Thursday exposure); postseason OT length unaffected.

event: Murphy v. NCAA: U.S. Supreme Court strikes down PASPA, ending the federal ban on state-level sports betting
mechanism_touched: Opens the door to state-by-state legal sportsbooks; market liquidity, number of books, and bettor access grow over subsequent years rather than changing on a single date
notes: Decided 2018-05-14. Delaware and New Jersey took the first legal bets outside Nevada within weeks; the national rollout was gradual and state-by-state through the following several years, not a single-season jump.

event: "Use of helmet" rule: 15-yard penalty and possible ejection for any player who lowers his head to initiate and make contact with the helmet, anywhere on the field
mechanism_touched: Broadens the old crown-of-the-helmet rule from ball carriers only to all players (tacklers, blockers, linemen); changes tackling/blocking technique incentives
notes: Reported: nearly 1-in-2 helmet-to-helmet hits caused a concussion in 2017 per NFL research, up from 1-in-3 in 2015 (unverified primary data).

event: Roughing-the-passer "body weight" rider tightened by a single conjunction change ("and" landing on the QB with weight -> "or")
mechanism_touched: Broadens what counts as an illegal takedown of the QB; produced a sharp, controversial spike in RTP flags in September 2018
notes: In-season point-of-emphasis on a rule dating to 1995, not a new rule; NFL Competition Committee explicitly declined to walk it back after a Sept 27, 2018 call.

event: Catch rule simplified: dropped the "going to the ground" element; a catch now needs control, two feet (or another body part) down, and a "football move"
mechanism_touched: Fewer overturned near-sideline/near-ground receptions; specifically designed to reverse outcomes like the 2014-playoff Dez Bryant non-catch
expected_signal_families: penalties (indirect, via reversed-call rates); coach fade
notes: Approved 32-0 by owners.

event: Offensive and defensive pass interference, including non-calls, made reviewable
mechanism_touched: Adds PI (a judgment penalty) to the replay-reviewable list for the first time in league history
notes: Passed 31-1 (Cincinnati dissenting) in direct reaction to the missed DPI no-call in the January 2019 NFC Championship Game. Explicitly a one-season rule; not renewed for 2020.

event: COVID-19 season: zero preseason games, a fully virtual offseason program, and no or sharply limited crowds at most stadiums for most of the season
mechanism_touched: Removes home-crowd noise/travel-fatigue advantage for much of the season; cuts practice-field reps ahead of Week 1, especially for rookies and new starters
notes: Attendance policy varied team-by-team and week-by-week by local public-health rules; this was not a clean 32-team binary and Task B should measure it, not assume full-season zero attendance league-wide.

event: Playoff field expands from 12 to 14 teams (7 seeds per conference), adding a Wild Card game
mechanism_touched: Changes end-of-season seeding incentives; more teams have something to play for in Weeks 16-18, fewer full-scale Week 17/18 tank/rest spots for the old 5th/6th seed bubble
notes: Part of the 2020 CBA package, first used for the 2020-21 postseason.

event: 2020 CBA ratified: practice squad expanded 10 -> 12 (permanent baseline), 17-game season authorized for a later season, playoff field expanded
mechanism_touched: More roster depth available for in-season injury replacement
notes: Ratified by a 1,019-959 player vote in March 2020. The 17th game's actual first season was 2021 (separate row below); practice squads were also temporarily bumped to 16 for COVID-19 season 2020 alone (see the covid row), on top of this permanent 12.

event: 17th regular-season game added (18-week regular season, one bye week)
mechanism_touched: More games per team per season; more short-week/international-game slots to schedule
notes: Authorized by the 2020 CBA; 2021 was the first season actually played at 17 games.

event: Playoff overtime rule change: both teams guaranteed at least one possession unless the first team's opening drive scores a TD
mechanism_touched: Removes the pure sudden-death-on-a-field-goal outcome specifically in the postseason
notes: Adopted at the March 2022 owners' meeting, 29-3, directly in response to the January 2022 Bills-Chiefs divisional-round game. Playoffs only; the regular season kept the 2012 rule until 2025 (separate row below).

event: Practice squad expanded again, 12 -> 14
mechanism_touched: Further roster-depth increase for in-season injury replacement
notes: Reported, unverified beyond this secondary summary of the 2020 CBA's phase-in schedule.

event: Fair catch anywhere behind a team's own 25-yard line on a kickoff is placed at the 25 (one-year trial)
mechanism_touched: Gives the receiving team a touchback-quality outcome without needing the ball to reach the end zone, cutting live returns further
notes: Reported: the league's own model predicted the return rate would drop from 38% to 31% (unverified primary data). Direct precursor to the 2024 dynamic-kickoff overhaul below.

event: "Tush push" (quarterback sneak with backfield push) proliferation, associated with the Philadelphia Eagles; a 2025 proposal to ban the play failed on a 16-16 owners' vote
mechanism_touched: Raises short-yardage / 4th-and-1 conversion rates for teams that adopt the play with a mobile, strong offensive line
notes: Not a rule change (the ban proposal was tabled, not passed) and not primarily a rule-driven event; season_effective=2023 is an approximate midpoint for when the play's league-wide usage became widely discussed, not a measured inflection point. Fuzzy boundary by construction.

event: "Dynamic kickoff": new setup alignment, a 20-yard "landing zone," and restricted player movement until the ball is touched, explicitly modeled on the XFL kickoff
mechanism_touched: Redesigns the kickoff from a high-speed collision play into something closer to a scrimmage play, aimed at raising the live-return rate while cutting injuries
notes: Reported (NFL Football Operations): kickoff return rate rose from 21.8% in 2023 to 32.8% in 2024, a full-season figure (unverified primary count by this agent). The 2023 season had the lowest kickoff-return rate in NFL history immediately before this change.

event: Dynamic kickoff made permanent; touchback spot on kickoffs moved to the 35-yard line
mechanism_touched: Raises the incentive to kick for a live return rather than take a touchback, versus the 2024 rule's touchback spot
notes: Read directly (fetched 2026-08-19) from this team-site republication of the owners'-meeting rules summary.

event: Regular-season overtime rules aligned with the playoff format: both teams get a possession regardless of the first result, 10-minute period, then sudden death
mechanism_touched: Ends the 2012-2024 regular-season rule where a first-drive touchdown ended the game immediately
notes: Proposed by the Philadelphia Eagles; passed at the 2025 Annual Meeting. Read directly (fetched 2026-08-19) from this republication.
